parsedVerdict.reasoning: The unit is one file, src/invoice/invoice.service.ts. Most of it is about invoices: `issue(orderId, amount)` and `countFor(orderId)` both work through the injected `Repository<InvoiceEntity>`. The problem is `validateCreate(quantity: number)`. It enforces a 'Quantity must be positive' rule, but nothing in the invoice abstraction has a quantity. `issue` takes `amount`, and the entity is built from `{ orderId, amount }`. `issue` also never calls `validateCreate`, so the check is not part of how invoices are created. It reads like an order-creation rule copied or misplaced into the invoice service. That puts a second, unrelated concern in this module, and that rule probably also exists in the module that owns quantity. I can't see the other modules, so I can't confirm the duplication. That is why confidence is moderate.
